chunks: Why do you solicit false gods instead of God?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about worshipping false gods instead of Allah?
ai.summary: In Surah As-Saff, this rhetorical question underscores the irrationality of polytheism by contrasting the inherent worthlessness of idols with the absolute sovereignty of Allah. Shia exegetes often view this as a critique of both external idolatry and internal spiritual neglect, reinforcing Tawhid as the foundation of correct worship and divine justice.
